title: October payments
instruction: Money is tight until my next paycheck. Please make sure my October rent, my October car-loan payment and my tuition installment are each paid in full by their deadlines, so that I pay no late fees. Don't pay any of them twice, don't overdraw my checking account, and don't let any payment bounce: my bank charges $25 when a scheduled payment runs without enough money in the account. Everything I have received about these payments is in my documents.

Maple Court Apartments - Management Office
September 24, 2026
To: Jordan Lee, Unit 4B
Re: Approved payment arrangement for October 2026 rent
As discussed on September 23, we have approved a payment arrangement for your October 2026 rent. The due date for your October 2026 rent of $1,400.00 is moved from October 1 to October 8, 2026. No late fee will be charged for October 2026 if the full $1,400.00 is received by October 8, 2026. Please pay through the resident portal as usual.
This arrangement applies to October 2026 only. November 2026 rent is due on November 1 as normal.
Signed: Dana Whitfield, Property Manager
